content: Wiura meta 'itsɨkame niukiyari
Merikɨtsɨ 'ikɨ 'ɨxatsi hepaɨtsita tikuxatatɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'ɨkitɨani kename heuyewetse yuheyemekɨ mɨyunenewiekakɨ, kawaɨripietɨ.
Mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «'Itsɨkame xeime kiekaritsie kanekateitɨni, Kakaɨyari pɨkamakarɨkai, pɨkawa'eniekai teɨteri.
Merikɨtsɨ 'uka kɨnaya mumɨ mana kanekateitɨni mɨkɨ kiekaritsie, 'itsɨkame hetsɨa kani'axekaitɨni mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: “Heitserie keneneupitɨa mɨnetsi'aye'unie yamɨkatiyurienenikɨ”.
Mɨixa pɨkayuwaɨriyakai 'itsɨkame, peru 'arike mɨpaɨ katiniyɨkɨhɨawekaitɨni: “Tsepa nemɨka'imakaxe Kakaɨyari, tsepa nemɨkawa'enie teɨteri,
'ikɨ 'ukaratsi kɨnaya mumɨ kanetini'uxitɨaka, mekuxi heitserie nekanipitɨamɨkɨ, tawariri mɨkanetsi'uximatɨakakɨ”».
Merikɨtsɨ Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: «Xekani'enieni niukieya kemutayɨ mɨkɨ 'itsɨkame heitseriemekɨ yamɨkatiyurienekai.
¿Kakaɨyari matsi heitserie katiwapitɨani mɨkɨ mɨwaranayexei tukarikɨ tɨkarikɨ memihiwie? ¿'Areutere kawaparewimɨtɨ?
Yanepɨtixekɨhɨawe, kwitɨ heitserie kaniwapitɨamɨkɨ. Matsi, kepauka nemunuani Yuri Tewi nehɨkɨtɨtɨ, ¿yuri mete'eriekame netiwataxeiya kwiepa 'aku?»
Paritseu meta tiwawame niukiyari
'Ipaɨta katini'ɨkitakaitɨni 'ɨxatsi hepaɨtsita tikuxatatɨ, hipatɨ yuhetsie yuri memɨte'eriekaikɨ kename heitseriemekɨ yametekahukai, mewaxani'erietɨ hipame, mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe:
«Teɨteri tukipa mekaneutiyune meyutanenewienike yuhutatɨ, xewitɨ paritseu pɨhɨkɨtɨkai, xewitɨta tewi kuwiyexinu hetsiemieme tiwawame pɨhɨkɨtɨkai.

Merikɨtsɨ paritseu mana 'utakeka nenewieri kaniyupitɨakaitɨni mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: “Kakaɨyari, pamɨpariyutsi nekamanipitɨaka hipame teɨteri wahepaɨ nemɨka'anekɨ ne ―mɨkɨ mepɨtenawaya, heitseriemekɨ yamepɨkatekahu, hipame wa'ɨitama mepɨwakumaɨwa― meta nitsikere 'ikɨ tiwawame hepaɨ nepɨka'ane.
Ne matsi hutakɨa nepunetihakiwa xexuime tsemanatsie, ne'iwarika tamamatatsie mieme xeime nepɨyetuaya tukita”.

Hikɨ tiwawame yatewa 'uwetɨ pɨkayuwaɨriyakai tsikere yuheima meutinierekɨ, matsi yutawitsie yukuhutsunatɨ hiwerikakɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutainekaitɨni: “Kakaɨyari 'aku, kene'awaɨriya 'aixɨa pemɨnetixeiyakɨ, 'axanetiyuruwametɨme”.

»Mɨpaɨ nepɨtixekɨhɨawe, mɨkɨ matsi yukie kaneyani heitserie hexeiyatɨ, paritseu pɨkatixaɨ. Yunaitɨ yuxaɨta mariweme memayuyeitɨwa tixaɨtɨ mekatehɨkɨtɨtɨ mekanayeitɨariekuni, peru kemɨ'ane tixaɨtɨ katihɨkɨtɨme mayuyeitɨwa mɨkɨ mariweme kanayeitɨariemɨkɨ».
Ketsutsi kemɨtiuyuri tɨɨri wahetsie
Merikɨtsɨta tɨɨri mekaniwa'atɨwakaitɨni hetsɨana wahetsie mutimenikɨ. Mewaruxeiyaka, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mekaniwarutate'akaitɨni memɨwa'atɨwakai.
Peru Ketsutsi yu'aurie kaniwarutahɨawe tɨɨri mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «Xekeniwapitɨaka tɨɨri nehetsɨa memɨ'axenikɨ, wahɨxie xepɨka'u'uka, mɨpaɨ memɨ'anene kaniwahetsiemiemetɨni Kakaɨyari mɨra'aita.
Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, kemɨ'ane mɨka'itanaki'erieni Kakaɨyari kemɨti'aita nunutsi hepaɨ yuri ti'erietɨ, pɨkayɨwe mana meutahani».
'Uki mɨxikutɨkai
Merikɨtsɨ xewitɨ teɨteri watsata mexɨakametɨtɨ mɨpaɨ katinita'iwawiya: —Ti'ɨkitame 'aixɨa pemɨtiuka'iyari, ¿tita reuyewetse kenetiyurieni, nehetsie mɨtinakekɨ tukari mɨkaxɨwe?
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: ¿Titayari 'aixɨa netiuka'iyarime penetixata? Tewi 'aixɨa mɨtiuka'iyari 'apɨka'uyeika, Kakaɨyari yuxewitɨ 'aixɨa pɨtiuka'iyari pɨta.
'Ekɨtsɨ 'aitsikate pepɨmate: “Xeime 'ɨyaya kɨnaya pepɨkakumaɨwani, pepɨkati'amemiwani, pepɨkatinawayani, xeimetsie pepɨkarahɨpani peti'itawatɨ, 'apaapa meta 'amaama keniwareu'enieka”.
'Iya mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Mɨkɨ naimetsie yanepɨtikamie temaikɨyari paitɨ.

Ketsutsi 'u'enaka mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Akuxi xewitɨ xeikɨa peuyewetse yapemɨtiyurieni: ketinetua 'apiinitɨarika naime, ketiniwarutamikwa haweri memɨ'anene, mɨpaɨ petiyurieme waɨkawa perexeiyatɨ pepayani taheima. 'Ana kenaye'a nehetsie ketineuwiya.
Kepauka tewi 'ikɨ niuki mu'eni, waɨkawa kaniyukahiwerieni waɨkawa mɨrexeiyakaikɨ.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi 'ixeiyaka waɨkawa yuheiweriekame, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Kanikwaniweni xikutsixi memeutahaxɨanikɨ Kakaɨyari mɨra'aitatsie.
Yurikɨ matsi, pɨkakwaniwe kameyu 'iwipame hɨxieyatsie manuyehanikɨ matsi pɨkwaniwe xiku meutahanikɨ Kakaɨyari mɨra'aitatsie.
Memɨ'enanakai mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Kamɨtsɨ, ¿kemɨ'ane pɨyɨwe mɨtawikweni?
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Teɨteri titatsie memɨkateyɨwawe, Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme katiniyɨweni.
Hikɨ Pekuru mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Neuxei, tame tapiini tepɨte'uku'eiri naime 'ahetsie temɨtewiyakɨ.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Yurikɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, kemɨ'ane mɨtiuku'eiri Kakaɨyari kemɨti'aita hetsiemieme yukii, yɨ'ɨya, yu'iwama, yupaapama yatɨni yɨtɨriyama,
mɨkɨ kwini mieme matsi waɨkawa warexeiyatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ hikɨ, meta tukari 'umamietsie kepauka maye'ani, tukari mɨkaxɨwe hexeiyatɨ kanayeimɨkɨ.
Tawari Ketsutsi kemutayɨ kemɨtimierienikekai

Hikɨ tamamata heimana memɨyuhuta yatewa warewitɨka mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Neuxei, Kerutsareme tekanitahuni hikɨ, naitɨ kemɨre'uxa Kakaɨyari niukametemama waxapatsie Yuri Tewi hepaɨtsita, naitɨ katinaye'amɨkɨ.
Nekaniyetuiyamɨkɨ mɨkɨ memɨkahuriyutsixi wahetsɨa. Nekanitewiyatsitɨariemɨkɨ, 'axanekatinitahɨawariemɨkɨ,
mekaneniti'aɨtsikawiyakuni meha'atɨ, hikɨ menetsikuwaxɨame mekanenimiekuni. Peru hairieka tukari 'aye'ayu nekananukuketɨariemɨkɨ».
Mɨkɨ 'atsimepɨkatemaikai tita mɨtixatakai. Niukieya matsi pɨ'awietsiekai wahetsiemieme, 'atsimepɨkatehetima kemɨtikuxatakai.
Makɨpekai kemɨranutanierixɨ kerikutanaka
Merikɨtsɨ Keriku kiekariyaritsie 'aye'aximekaku Ketsutsi, xewitɨ tewi mɨkaheuniere mana huye tetsita kaniukateitɨni tiwautɨ.
Hikɨ waru'enieka yumɨireme teɨteri me'anuyekɨkame kaniuta'iwauni kemɨtiyɨanekai.
Mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe kename Ketsutsi natsaretitanaka mana 'uyemiekai.
Hikɨ mɨkaheuniere karima kaniutahiwa mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —Ketsutsi, Rawiri pemɨnu'aya, keneneutinenimayata kwerietɨ.
Memanuyetekai mekanitate'akaitɨni kayuwatɨ mɨtikanikɨ, peru matsi mɨkɨ karima mɨpaɨ katiniuhiwakaitɨni: —Rawiri pemɨnu'aya 'aku, keneneutinenimayata kwerietɨ.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mana 'utakeka kanita'aita mahanienikɨ hetsɨana. Nuaku 'auriena mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe:
—¿Tita pereuyehɨwa kenetiyurieni 'ahetsiemieme? Mɨkɨ rehɨawe: —Ti'aitame, nepeunierenikeyu.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Peheunieretɨ kenaye'a. Yuri pemɨti'eriekɨ 'aixɨa pe'anetɨ pepatɨa.
Yapauka heunieretɨ kanayani. Hikɨ 'aixɨa 'utaitɨ Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita, Ketsutsi 'utɨa kaneyani, meta yunaitɨ teɨteri memixei witsimekaniutiyuanekaitɨni Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita.
